text: 金十数据8月30日讯，根据发行安排，下周有3只新股可申购：8月31日可申购北交所新股百迈科；9月2日可申购上交所科创板新股燧原科技；9月3日可申购上交所科创板新股信诺维。 其中，燧原科技与摩尔线程、沐曦股份、壁仞科技被合称为“国产GPU四小龙”，当前仅有燧原科技尚未上市。随着燧原科技上市，“国产GPU四小龙”将齐聚资本市场。此前，摩尔线程、沐曦股份、壁仞科技在上市首日的收盘涨幅分别为425.46%、692.95%、75.82%。 燧原科技披露的招股意向书显示，拟发行4303.5173万股，占发行后总股本的10%，发行后总股本约4.30亿股。本次IPO拟募
text_en: Jinshi Data August 30 - According to issuance arrangements, three new stocks are available for subscription next week: Baimaike on the Beijing Stock Exchange on Aug 31; Suiyuan Technology on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market on Sep 2; and Xinowei on the STAR Market on Sep 3. Among them, Suiyuan Technology, along with Moore Threads, Muxi, and Biren Technology, are collectively known as the "Four Little Dragons of domestic GPUs," with only Suiyuan Technology yet to list. With Suiyuan's listing, the "Four Little Dragons" will all be on the capital market. Previously, Moore Threads, Muxi, and Biren closed up 425.46%, 692.95%, and 75.82% respectively on their debut days. Suiyuan Technology's prospectus shows plans to issue 43.035 million shares, accounting for 10% of post-issuance total share capital, with post-issuance total share capital of about 430 million shares.
